name: Sam Baccei
blurb: Sam is a 3rd year student from Cincinnati, majoring in CIS with a minor in Math. He has industry experience with software development and data policy, and is excited to combine this background with a deep passion for leadership to further the mission of CSD. He hopes to help members succeed in the club, in the classroom, and in their careers. In the past, he has participated in the games, programming language, and mobile app teams. Outside of the club, Sam is the Service Chair for Triangle Fraternity, performs in Collegiate Winds, and enjoys fishing.

name: Lorenzo Mion
blurb: Lorenzo, an international student from Brazil, is a sophomore Computer Science and Engineering major serving as Web Project Lead. Lorenzo is familiar with a range of programming languages, but his expertise lies in web development, particularly with technologies like React and Next.js. As the project lead, he is dedicated to fostering a dynamic and engaging learning environment where he and other engineers can hone their web development skills by working on diverse projects. Additionally, Lorenzo is also a member of Ohio State’s varsity fencing team and Brazil's national team

name: Trevor Kosht
blurb: Trevor has a special interest in virtual reality and aspires to build a future where people can live virtually. His skills as a designer are showcased as hir role as lead designer on the unity projects. His role as secretary allows him to foster his talents for scheduling and management. He hopes to build an inclusive environment for anyone to experience the joy of problem solving in a collaborative manner within the collaborative software development club.

name: Caleb Sanders
blurb: Caleb has had a passion for computers since a young age. He started off with making small games in Scratch, but over time he's built up to creating complex games in both Unity and Godot. He's joined the club for the sake of further developing his skills in both programming and teamwork. His role as secretary allows him to make use of his love for data and organization to ensure that the club can operate with efficiency.

name: Caleb Cope
blurb: Description and image: Hi! I’m a junior Computer Engineering major from Toledo, Ohio, with a focus on game development and experience in web and mobile apps. I’m currently an iOS development intern at FOX Sports. Outside of school and work, I enjoy playing guitar, basketball, video games, and discovering new music. As the Social Coordinator of this club, my goal is to foster a connected and engaging environment where every member feels welcome and involved.

name: Tristan Leedy
blurb: Tristan is a rising senior majoring in Computer Science & Engineering and serves as Treasurer for CSDC. He frequently contributes to the Unity team as a hobbyist game developer but plans to pursue a career in backend engineering. His experience focuses on Java, test automation, and database/SQL setup. He hopes to continue fostering a supportive environment where developers of all skill levels feel welcome and confident collaborating on projects. An active member of OSU’s Run Club, Tristan has also recently discovered a love for pickleball.
